scope: Only canonical corpus metadata and formally audited theorem batch 001-020.

definitions.raw_observations: Nonblank provider-observation rows before canonical family deduplication.
definitions.canonical_paper_families: Rows in data/papers/papers.jsonl, each representing one canonical paper family.
definitions.relevant_paper_families: Canonical families whose deterministic screening record has relevant=true.
definitions.full_scan_papers: Source-verified papers counted as FULL_SCAN by the frozen read-depth ledger; includes DEEP_READ.
definitions.deep_read_papers: Source-verified papers counted as DEEP_READ by the frozen read-depth ledger.
definitions.records_with_source_locations: Audited theorem rows containing a nonempty source_location object.
definitions.audited_version_families: Distinct version_id values among audited theorem rows.

exclusions: No theorem records from batches 021-040 are used.
No theorem extraction claim is made for papers 041-080.
Counts do not estimate completeness, extraction accuracy, effectiveness, adoption, or open-problem status.
